lines.say: Missed a few days of revision, and now it feels pointless to start again?
So you make a brand new plan. From day one. Again.
Offload doesn't make you start over.
Miss a day, and it moves the work into your free time, and tells you what moved.
Come back after a bad week, and your calendar's already sorted.
Offload. A study system that adapts when real life happens.
